title.narrative: Meeting the basic food needs of the most needy groups in Yemen

description.narrative: Avert famine by providing immediate food assistance to as many people currently experiencing severe food insecurity as possible in Yemen in 2022 Strengthen food security, livelihoods and resilience of affected families and communities

Integration of food security, livelihoods and the resilience of food-insecure families in 7 Yemeni governorates, according to the latest classification of the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) 2022 report - the purchase and distribution of 16,908 tons of wheat flour. - Food assistance for assets (FFA) for 1,000 people.

The project aims to avert famine by providing immediate food assistance to as many people as possible who are currently suffering from acute food insecurity in Yemen in 2022, and aims to enhance food security, livelihoods and the resilience of affected families and communities.
